messages.name: Nakatomi Trading admin
messages.body: If we add 10 seats now, are they prorated to our renewal date?

messages.name: Sam (Support)
messages.body: Added seats aren't prorated. They're billed at the full per-seat price and start their own 12-month term.

messages.name: Nakatomi Trading admin
messages.body: OK. Please let us know when it's fixed.
